name: sprint43_volspike_drift_spy_v4_loader_verified
hypothesis: Volume-spike-conditioned drift on SPY 1m RTH bars; equity close-auction and news-volume regime is a distinct mechanism from the three closed crypto volspike universes. Prior SPY runs (sprint38/39/41) had n=0 from loader defects, not evidence.
power_argument: SPY 30m stdev ~20bp; SE at n=300 ~1.15bp; min detectable edge at t=2 ~2.3bp, but PASS requires net-of-T2 t>=2 so gross must exceed ~28bp. 1 symbol x ~63 validation RTH days x cap10/day = up to 630 entries, above the 300 floor. The null can fail: C0 on the same loader must show net ~-26bp.
prerequisite: backtest_auditor confirms n>0 on research window and C0/C1 pass on the new loader before scoring
